name: Chicken Breast with Zesty Bacon Ranch Sauce, Broccoli & Couscous (Prep-Ahead)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe utilizes 4 medium food storage containers.

In a medium saucepan, bring water and salt to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, remove from heat, add couscous, and stir to combine. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes; fluff with a fork right before serving.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ tsp salt
1 cup whole wheat couscous

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and juice lemon into a small bowl. Add yogurt, mayo, and spices, then whisk to combine the ranch sauce. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 lemon
½ cup plain Greek yogurt
¼ cup mayonnaise
1 tsp dill, dried
¼ tsp parsley flakes
¼ tsp onion powder
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, medium dice bacon.

Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 4-5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove crispy bacon to a paper towel-lined plate; set aside. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry broccoli. Using a clean cutting board, separate broccoli into bite-sized florets; cut stems into smaller pieces. Place in a medium bowl and set aside.
Pat the chicken dry with paper towels. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with spices.
instructions.secondary_message:
680 g chicken breasts, boneless skinless
½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Return skillet (with drippings) to medium-high heat. Add chicken cutlets and pan-fry until golden, 1-2 minutes per side (the chicken will not be cooked all the way through).

When the chicken is golden, add ranch sauce to the skillet and bring to a simmer. Remove from heat, add broccoli, then place in the oven and bake until the broccoli is fork-tender and chicken is cooked through, 12-15 minutes. Remove from oven.

Divide couscous, broccoli, chicken, and sauce between storage containers. Sprinkle with bacon and allow to cool completely, about 20 minutes. Once cool, cover containers and refrigerate. When ready to eat, heat in the oven or microwave and enjoy!
